scope: Compare the existing AutoCAD 2007 metric FIELD source with an ODA 27.1.0.0 macOS ARM64 AC1021 resaved derivative and its DXF.
checks: The ODA-resaved AC1021 file has all 162 original FIELD handles and 162 changed raw frames. ODA DXF retains 162 FIELDs and one FIELDLIST; ezdxf 1.4.5 reports zero audit errors and fixes.

For 42 selected AcObjProp carriers, both original and resaved source frames contain matching candidate in-body UTF-16 byte arrays at bits 309–564 with the same decoded values and two object references. The resaved frames use absolute role-4 owners where the originals use relative role-8 owners.

The other 24 selected raw-only carriers have 58 candidate value spans in both sources and match the ODA DXF and ACadSharp 3a52a520 peer. Some spans shift by eight bits after resave; they are checked independently, not assumed byte-identical.

The shared observer explicitly checks relative versus absolute owner roles; wrong roles, payload changes, an invalid input digest and corrected retries are tested. The prior original-source verifier still passes.

Fresh libdxfrw strict and explicit-partial conversions of the derivative refuse before replacing the destination; the latter reports that FIELD/FIELDLIST carriers lack a qualified serializer. Source release inventory check and self-test pass.
limits: The ODA file is a resaved derivative, and the converter could preserve encoded source values. It is not an independent authored witness and does not establish AutoCAD/native semantics.

ODA v5.4.1 remains the repository authority: the observed in-body byte-array interpretation conflicts with its R2007+ Unicode string-stream rule. The LibreDWG diff also proposes BL for FIELD group 98 where v5.4.1 prints TV; that is a non-authoritative implementation comparison and does not resolve the value-stream conflict.
No raw-only FIELD is promoted, no serializer is admitted, and no external DWG/DXF fixture is committed.
